cand.title: 10th International Workshop on Grapevine Downy and Powdery Mildews
cand.excerpt: Ranks on verified event mechanism and geography; penalized where venue is committed or hotel sourcing is unconfirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No named GDPM2027 accommodation buyer, contracting officer, PCO or edition committee member was verified. The proven event enquiry channel is info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch. Two named institutional referral candidates are Katia Gindro (Mycology) and Vivian Zufferey (Viticulture), as listed in the official organisation chart dated 1 October 2026. Their subject-matter relevance is evidenced; their participation in this edition and hotel-contract authority are not.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced 10th edition: 13–16 July 2027, Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland; within the requested horizon and future as of 16 November 2026. These are workshop activity dates, not the 5 October 2026 announcement date. Registration opened 1 October 2026; early-bird deadline 31 January 2027. No later edition was identified in the reviewed official material.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a geographically relevant Founex / La Côte lodging option for a Nyon research workshop, rather than downtown-Geneva megashow housing. Best plausible role is a modest delegate/speaker room allocation, potentially with breakfast and separately agreed transfers to Changins; satellite meals or small meetings are secondary possibilities only if requested. The scientific sessions are already placed at Agroscope. Historical attendance of 30 (2017, unusually small), 75 (2014) and 98 (2010) is consistent with a specialist event, but does not forecast 2027 attendance or bedrooms. The hotel’s 20–120-room commercial band is a sales constraint, not published event demand; do not offer the whole 237-room hotel or assume 120 rooms. Resort exclusivity is not demonstrated as a requirement.
findings.venueCommitments: Meeting venue publicly confirmed: Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland. This is Nyon / La Côte, in the hotel’s primary demand territory; not Geneva city or Lausanne, and not a competing hotel. The event-specific address is 52; Agroscope’s general Changins site page gives Route de Duillier 60, so use the edition-specific Aula address. Public venue confirmation is not evidence of a hotel contract or open room inventory.
findings.historicalRotation: International institution-led rotation is documented, not an annual Nyon commitment. Recent verified editions: Bordeaux 4–9 July 2010; Vitoria-Gasteiz 30 June–4 July 2014; Corvallis scientific workshop 17–19 July 2017; Cremona 20–22 July 2022; Nyon 13–16 July 2027. The 2022 retrospective lists France 2009 and Spain 2013, conflicting with detailed participant reports; use 2010 and 2014. Earlier retrospective locations are included below with limited date precision. The official series description says every three to four years, but the last two observed gaps are five years. Do not project another Swiss edition or exact next date.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific pre-reservations exist: the official homepage states, “Deadline for booking pre-reserved hotel rooms: 31 March 2027” and “Detailed travel and accommodation information is available on the Practical Information page.” The linked practical-information page could not be retrieved and no alternative hotel list was recovered. Verified hotel names: none available from the accessible evidence; this does not mean no hotels are reserved. Host hotel, every incumbent hotel, allocated rooms, rates, booking mechanism, housing bureau and ability to add suppliers remain unknown. No open RFP was found; do not label hotel sourcing open.
findings.organizationStructure: Agroscope is the verified 2027 organizer. It is a public agricultural research institution affiliated with Switzerland’s Federal Office for Agriculture, not demonstrated to be a membership association, corporate event agency, PCO or DMC. Its official structure comprises three competence divisions, seven strategic research divisions and a Resources Unit. The event-series owner/legal contracting entity beyond the named edition organizer is not established. Sciencesconf provides registration/account infrastructure; that is not proof of housing or procurement authority.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The Aula is incumbent for meetings, so meeting-venue displacement is not a credible primary pitch. Pre-reserved hotel rooms indicate an existing accommodation arrangement, but incumbent hotel identities and contracted scope are unresolved. No sourced sell-out, overflow, waitlist, room shortage or dissatisfaction evidence was found. Founex-to-Changins delegate transfers and competitiveness against the existing lodging offer require confirmation; no journey time or shuttle commitment is established.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch now, identify YOTEL Geneva Lake as a Founex accommodation option, and request referral to the named accommodation/logistics decision-maker. Ask for the complete 2027 pre-reserved hotel list, allocation and release terms, delegate forecast, stay dates, booking/payment channel, transfer requirements and whether an additional hotel is admissible. Only then propose a right-sized block and optional transfer pricing. Seek introduction to Katia Gindro or Vivian Zufferey only as institutional referrals, not presumed buyers. Keep meeting relocation and speculative overflow out of the initial pitch.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Confirmed upcoming event, but accommodation-supplier accessibility is unconfirmed. The 31 March 2027 hotel deadline is a delegate booking cutoff, not a supplier-bid invitation. Approach as a possible supplementary lodging/referral provider before that cutoff, subject to organizer acceptance and incumbent obligations. Do not mark this as open sourcing or lodging definitively committed elsewhere.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize a repeat institutional relationship with Agroscope for relevant local workshops and visitors, rather than assuming the rotating international series will return to Nyon. A future GDPM edition has no verified date, destination or hotel competition in the evidence reviewed. Recurrence supports relationship development, not a bookable future Swiss cycle.
